author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 4; ensure at least four current turns classified as account_security across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer locked out of account after changing phone number

messages.content: I changed my phone number last week and now I can't get the login code sent to me.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can help you regain access. Could you confirm the email address on your account?
It's jennifer.k@gmail.com. I really need to place an order today for a birthday gift.
Thanks, Jennifer. I've sent a verification link to that email. Please click it to reset your login method.

variants.text: I clicked the link but it says expired. Can you send another one?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Actually, forget it. I'll just create a new account with my new number.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Wait, before I do that — do you still have that ceramic vase I looked at last month in stock?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer asks about a suspicious charge on their card

messages.content: I see a charge from your store for $89.99 that I don't recognize.
Let me look into that. Can you tell me the last four digits of the card used?
It ends in 4412. I haven't bought anything from you in months.
I found the transaction — it was placed yesterday under an account with your name but a different shipping address.

variants.text: That's definitely not me. Someone must have gotten into my account. Please lock it immediately.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Hmm, could it have been my husband? He sometimes uses my card. Let me check with him first.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: While you're at it, can you tell me if the return window for my last order has closed?
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer forgot password and also wants shipping update

messages.content: I can't remember my password and the reset link isn't arriving in my inbox.
Let me check — could the email be in spam or promotions? Also, which email is on file?
I checked spam already. It's mark.turner@outlook.com. Nothing came through.
I've resent the link to that address. Please allow a few minutes and check again.

variants.text: Still nothing. This is the second time. Can you verify my email is spelled correctly on the account?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Oh wait, I think I remember now — my password might be saved on my work computer. Never mind.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Thanks. Also, my package from last Tuesday was supposed to arrive today but tracking hasn't updated since Friday.
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer wants to talk to a person about account fraud

messages.content: I think someone used my account to buy gift cards. I want to speak to a real person about this.
I understand your concern. I can help you directly, or I can connect you to our fraud team.
I'd rather talk to a human. This is stressful and I don't trust bots with this.
Of course. I'll transfer you to a specialist. May I place you on a brief hold?

variants.text: Yes, please transfer me. And while I wait, can you at least tell me if those gift cards were redeemed?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Actually, on second thought, just tell me how to change my password myself and I'll handle it.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: No, never mind. I'll just dispute it with my bank instead. Thanks anyway.
variants.label: __DEFER__

families.scenario: Customer asks about two-factor authentication setup

messages.content: I keep getting logged out of my account on my phone. It's really annoying.
That can happen if your session cookies are cleared or if two-factor authentication was recently enabled. Are you seeing a code prompt?
Yes, every single time. I never set that up myself.
That's concerning. It may indicate someone enabled 2FA on your account without your knowledge. Let's secure it.

variants.text: Please remove the two-factor setting and reset my password right away.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Hmm, actually my teenage son borrowed my phone last week. Maybe he turned it on as a prank.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Okay, but first — do you sell screen protectors for the Pixel 9? I dropped my phone yesterday.
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer asks about a package delivered to wrong address

messages.content: My order says delivered but it went to my old apartment. I moved three months ago.
I'm sorry about that. Did you update your default shipping address in your profile after moving?
I thought I did, but clearly not. The package is at 42 Maple Street now.
I see. Unfortunately the carrier has marked it as delivered. I can file a claim on your behalf.

variants.text: Please do. Also, can you update my saved address so this doesn't happen again?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, I just realized my old roommate still lives there. Let me text her to grab it.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Before that — I noticed my account shows an old email too. Can you check what contact info is on file?
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer wants general help navigating the website

messages.content: Hi, I'm new here. Is there a way to see all items on sale at once?
Welcome! Yes, you can click 'Deals' in the top menu, or filter by discount percentage under any category.
Great, that helps. Also, how do I save items to a wishlist?
On each product page, there's a heart icon next to 'Add to Cart'. Click it to save the item to your wishlist.

variants.text: Perfect, thanks so much for your help!
variants.label: general

variants.text: Got it. One more thing — I can't log in on the app even though my browser works fine.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Thanks. Actually, I'd like to speak with someone about a bulk order for my office. Is that possible?
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer complains about a defective blender and wants a replacement

messages.content: The blender I bought two weeks ago stopped spinning. The motor hums but the blades don't turn.
I'm sorry for the trouble. That sounds like a motor issue. Since it's within 30 days, you're eligible for a replacement.
Good. Do I need to send the old one back first, or will you ship the new one right away?
We'll ship the replacement immediately and include a prepaid return label for the defective unit.

variants.text: Perfect, please start the replacement order. My original order number is 88412.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, can I just get a refund instead? I'd rather buy a different brand.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Hold on — I also noticed my account was accessed from a different city yesterday. Can you check that?
variants.label: account_security
